$comment: GENERATED by scripts/pin-schema.mjs. If this grew, a feature added a field to everyone's Markdown. That is a design conversation (see §34), not a merge.

$why.source, source-id: Added 2026-09-08 for Apple Notes import (2d), admitted deliberately. §34 asks: if someone never uses Notes import, does their Markdown need these? No — they appear only on lines that came from a note, exactly as [reminder:] appears only on a task projected outward. An ordinary capture written in the editor carries neither. Earned identity (I6), not a universal tax.
